close_reason: Adopted extras policy across 33 in-scope types in jmap-chat-types per the canonical pattern from JMAP-lbdy.2. Tagged-enum + flatten compatibility verified for EphemeralMessage and ChatMessagePush. cargo test --workspace --all-features: 1702 (+33 new). Commit 2957e6e.
description:
Apply the workspace extras-preservation policy (JMAP-lbdy) to crate-jmap-chat-types.

In scope (estimate ~15-20 public wire-shaped Deserialize structs):
- Chat + nested: Member, Role
- Message + nested: MessageAction, ReactionGroup, ReadDisposition struct types (if any)
- Space + nested: Channel, Category, MemberRole (if struct)
- ChatContact, Endpoint, NetworkAddress (if struct)
- ReadPosition
- CustomEmoji
- SpaceInvite
- SpaceBan
- PresenceStatus
- Federation peer types (if defined)
- WebSocket ephemeral types
- Push subscription types

Out of scope:
- Filter / Comparator algebra types.
- String-enum types (ChatKind, DeliveryState, etc.).
- Property selector enums.

Cookie-cutter consistency: jmap-chat-types follows the same extension-types shape as the canonical jmap-mail-types per workspace AGENTS.md (and is itself a normative reference for the JMAP Chat draft). Scope and field-shape are inherited from parent epic JMAP-lbdy and apply identically to every sibling extension-types crate. Each in-scope struct adds one field with the documented attribute; no public types added/renamed/removed.

Acceptance: every in-scope struct has `pub extra: Map<String, Value>` with the documented attributes; one round-trip preservation test per type; PLAN.md updated; cargo test/clippy/fmt clean.
title: Adopt extras policy in jmap-chat-types
